episode_summary: In this episode, Justin Black shares how he uses AI to generate nearly $5 million in real estate listings by optimizing his website content for AI search engines. He discusses his strategy for working with expired listings by sending personalized FedEx packages and leveraging AI to automate content creation. Justin's insights offer actionable tactics for agents looking to harness the power of AI in their real estate business.
